vector_memory.semantic_summary: TorusHelper is a low-level geometry utility responsible for generating and managing the vertex and index data required to render a torus shape in a 3D scene. It calculates complex 3D coordinates based on user-defined radii and segment counts, populating WebGL buffers. Its primary function is to provide pre-calculated mesh data to other scene components for rendering via a provided Shader.
